title: The Mattock makes its wind-up twice a swing
description: With his back to a yeti king, the player swings a mattock: its wind-up is made behind him twice, and the two take 12 of the yeti king's 30 hit points in four steps, 2, 4, 4 and 2. The hit in front breaks the block under him, and he drops into the hole.
